entities.name: UniProt P57721 PCBP3
observations: Exact sequence match to the 371-aa human poly(rC)-binding protein 3 reference; identity and coverage are both 100%, E-value 8.96e-268.
Contains three KH RNA-binding domains: KH1 at residues 45–95, KH2 at 129–182, and KH3 at 293–357.
Curated function: single-stranded nucleic-acid-binding protein with preference for oligo(dC).
Curated/localization evidence places the protein in cytoplasm/cytosol and nucleus; extracellular exosome annotation is also recorded.
Associated biological processes include mRNA metabolic process, regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II, and viral RNA genome replication.

entities.name: Poly(rC)-binding protein
observations: PCBP proteins are modular single-stranded nucleic-acid-binding proteins characterized by multiple KH domains.

entities.name: mRNA metabolic process
observations: PCBP3 is annotated in mRNA metabolic process; this is consistent with its multi-KH RNA-binding architecture.

entities.name: RNA polymerase II transcription regulation
observations: PCBP3 is annotated in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

entities.name: Viral RNA genome replication
observations: PCBP3 has a curated annotation for participation in viral RNA genome replication; the specific role may depend on virus and host context.
